notes: The two participles converted to coordinate finite clauses each take the juncture that introduces them (rule 88).
ἐκφυγεῖν keeps only its verb word, the expressed ἐκ taking the whole 'out of' under rules 36 and 106.
τοῦ before οἴκου is unrepresented under rule 38, the demonstrative ἐκείνου occupying the English determiner slot.
